# Camp Ally: Sam Nguyen

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Aug 6, 2023
- 2 min read

Updated: Dec 21, 2023

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e0583e2404fa4be98093c759bee45054~mv2.jpg)

#### **Type**

Lite Ally

Lite Allies do not offer a daily/repeatable quest, they are most often vendors and offer buffs in return for you letting them sleep at your camp.

#### **Specialises in**

Handyman and Music

#### **Faction**

N/A

#### **Lore**

Sam's background can be found __here__. 

**Health Bar (HP)** 

534 HP

#### **Camp Item**

Sam's Workbench.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_66fa3ff85092441d93da5c136c36c308~mv2.jpg)

#### **Flamingo Units**

4x Flamingo Units

Flamingo Unit camp item cost __spreadsheet__ 

#### **Obtainable from**

- Season 8 scoreboard - A Better Life Underground (free)
- Gold Bullion - Samuel at Foundation once you have reached Ally status with the Settlers (4000 Gold Bullion)

**Daily Quest**

N/A

**Buffs/Services**

24-hour cool down period on all buffs and services excluding the Well Rested/Lover's Embrace buff.

Well Rested - +5% XP for 3 hours

Sam will randomly give you one of the five buffs below, once every 24 hours, when you interact with him.

All of Sam's buffs stack with magazines, backpack perks, and perk cards.

**Tune Up - Carry Junk**

Cost: Free

Lasts: 30 minutes

Buff: The weight of all junk items is reduced by 50%.

Stacks with: Pack Rat Perk Card and Scrap Rat Backpack Mod. Caps at 0.01 pounds each.

**Tune Up - Crafting Workshop**

Cost: Free

Lasts: 30 minutes

Buff: Crafting workshop items costs 25% fewer materials

Stacks with: Contractor Perk Card.

**Tune Up - Repair Items**

Cost: Free

Lasts: 30 minutes

Buff: You can repair weapons, armour, and Power Armour to 130% of normal maximum conditions.

Stacks with: Does not stack with the "Fix It Good" Perk Card.

**Tune Up - Harvest**

Cost: Free

Lasts: 30 minutes

Buff: Reap twice as much when harvesting wood or flora.

Stacks with: Green Thumb, Backwoodsman #4, Verdant Season, and Woodchucker.

**Tune Up - Charisma**

Cost: Free

Lasts: 30 minutes

Buff: Charisma increased by 2.

Stacks with: All Charisma buffs.

Hi, I'm Kat or Duchess

I'm an Australian data miner who writes farming, event, and food buff guides for Fallout 76 and Starfield.

I believe that all knowledge and information should be free, which is why my guides will never be locked behind a paywall. However, running a website and photo and video editing software does not come cheaply.

So, If you found my guides helpful, please consider buying me a ko-fi (coffee) using the link below.

All monies go towards the tools for writing my guides and maybe for an actual cup of coffee or 3 ;)

Alternatively, share my guides with your fellow vault dwellers and help them to survive the wasteland.
